name: Veil Moth
behaviour: Fast and floating. Flutters about in swarms of ten, then dives at the hero with a quick telegraphed strike.
look: A small pale-dust body with feathery antennae, cyan eyes and two translucent violet wings that beat fast and faster still when it dives.
lore: Moths that flew too close to the Veil's light and never left it. They drink the warmth of the living and scatter as soul-dust when struck.
